known_outcome: Regulator position: a building SCO reviews and inspects the design and construction of an ESS room where the room provisions are in CE Code Part 1; a building permit is required for construction in the building discipline; alternative wall, ceiling and floor locations may be considered with AHJ acceptance.
review_focus: Separates the discipline question from the permit question
Asks which CE Code Part 1 rule and NBC(AE) assemblies the room design relies on
Flags AHJ acceptance for alternative assembly locations
Does not state the room complies
alberta_evaluation_use: source extraction and administrative evidence exercise; not technical approval
instruction: Do not upload this file with the test prompt. Published outcome is not a new technical approval or a complete scored ground truth.
